answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before trading, slashed if peers prove duplicate identities or fraud. Like ships queuing at a jetty, each identity waits for verification and pays in compute and collateral, so cloning thousands of accounts is expensive, not free. Reputation builds on one knoll of verifiable history - completed deliveries, escrow releases, and peer attestations - while a fresh clone starts at zero trust with tight quotas. Even when a gale of new accounts arrives, stake plus rate limits keep a Sybil flood costlier than any reward it could steal.
